validated_description: A read-only smoke test task to inspect the current repository identity, validate the environment state (source, git, dependencies), and ensure no unauthorized mutations occur, returning a minimal verification PRD.
acceptance_criteria: Command `git rev-parse HEAD` matches the current workspace HEAD SHA.
Command `git status --porcelain` returns an empty output (no uncommitted changes).
Command `ls -R` or similar confirms no new files were created in the repository root during the smoke test.
The output of the smoke test includes the current repository identity (name, path, and git SHA).
must_have: Verification of the current Git HEAD SHA.
Verification that the working directory is clean (no uncommitted changes).
Verification that no files or directories were created or modified in the repository during execution.
Output containing the current repository identity.
nice_to_have: Verification of the current branch name.
Verification of the current user/identity context.
out_of_scope: Modifying any source code or configuration files.
Creating or modifying any Git branches or commits.
Running any non-read-only commands that impact the filesystem state.
